items.question: Who is Kiara Leslie?
items.answer: Kiara Leslie is an American professional basketball player who most recently played for the Washington Mystics of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA).

items.answer: Her most recent WNBA team on record is the Washington Mystics. She wears No. 5. Her listed position is Guard.
